entries.speaker: Hiding
entries.en: Move [clr 2][f 1 10 45][clr 27] to look around while hiding.

entries.speaker: Hiding
entries.en: Moving [clr 2][f 1 10 43][clr 27] lets you change the direction faced[n]or leap to an adjacent location.

entries.speaker: Hiding
entries.en: Not only can you ambush the enemy while hiding,[n]but you can also [clr 2]avoid enemy contact[clr 27] and [clr 2]loot[n]nearby treasure caches[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Hiding
entries.en: If there are multiple adjacent locations you could[n]move to, use [f 1 10 78] to choose your destination.[n]You can also use [f 1 10 76] to focus on enemies or[n][f 1 10 77] to focus on treasure caches.
